title: Wanderburg Trailer — Official Reveal & Where to Watch
description: Wanderburg trailer links: official reveal on YouTube and Randwerk channel context for players searching gameplay footage.

paragraphs: The primary official reveal trailer used across our research is on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pUsprNYfxw0
Watch it for tone, castle-driving fantasy, and siege module spectacle before you jump into the Steam demo.
Randwerk’s YouTube channel (@randwerk2760) is the safest place to find additional official clips as Early Access updates land.
Third-party gameplay videos help for tips, but treat numbers and unlock claims as unverified until you see them in your own build.
Next reads on this wiki: Beginner Guide for the core loop, Demo for how to install the free Steam build, and Best Build for early sustain packages.
If you only needed confirmation that a trailer exists, the reveal link above is the canonical starting point we cite in the footer and homepage.
